commands.name: bus
commands.description: Show the CrabBus panel: every subagent, what it is doing and what it reported
commands.output: Agents panel opened (click or 1-9 to inspect an agent, b to go back).

commands.name: costume
commands.description: Crab designs: list | export <id…> | import <file> | migrate [--dry-run] | folder | reload
commands.output: Wardrobe opened in the side panel.

commands.name: disfraz
commands.description: Alias for /costume (crab designs: list | export | import | migrate | folder | reload)
commands.output: Wardrobe opened in the side panel.

tools.name: bus_step
tools.description: For subagents: report your plan and progress to the master (plan, done, current, note, evidence, blocker, question, reply, ack, applied). Cheap; it only records state.

tools.name: bus_status
tools.description: For the master: what every subagent is doing right now. Three layers per agent: OBSERVED (hooks), DECLARED (its own bus_step reports), VERIFIED (declared stages with evidence), plus message delivery. Address SendMessage by the agent id shown here. Optional agent filter (id, name or part of its description).

children: Ask for anything in your own words: a new costume ("a pumpkin crab, like the September 2026 meme"), when each one is worn, who is the master. Claude does it with the design skill and looks things up on the web when it needs to. For a picture, paste its file path.

props.placeholder: type here: make me a pumpkin crab…

children: click the field and type · Enter sends it to Claude
In rotation: agents no rule matches take turns wearing it. Master: the crab at the top of the panel, this session.
No rule gives it and it is out of the rotation: nobody wears it.
+ TELL CRABBUS ABOUT master: when it is worn, how it looks, anything

props.placeholder: type here: wear master when planning, or give it a bigger hat…

children: ▸ or set it by hand (for experienced users)
Every costume, tried from the top before the built-in rules: the first that fits dresses the agent. Click a costume to open it.
None yet: pick a costume above and add one in its card.
